gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-sora: Sora keeps its curves crisp and geometric, while Liu Jian Mao Cao scrawls above it in one casual, pen-traced line. The handwriting against the sans is the draw, best kept brief.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hepta-sl: Stout and showy: Love Ya Like A Sister barely lifts its ascenders. Hepta Slab, a serif with open counters and a bookish, dignified tone, carries long paragraphs with room to breathe.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-neco: Lumanosimo writes with casual grace, every stroke drawn at the weight of a wire. Neco steps in with authority, its serif strokes swelling gently, a dignified partner best left to brief lines.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-recia: Loose, pen-drawn grace: LXGW WenKai TC curves freely in one unvarying line. Recia follows with authoritative, sharp serifs and a modulation you notice only up close, ready for longer reading than the heading.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-synonym: Graceful, LXGW WenKai TC loops along like an unhurried pen. Synonym, a dependable sans with generous curve openings, keeps things tidy and clear beneath it, happiest over brief stretches.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-outfit: Outfit draws clean, approachable curves that stop before they close. LXGW WenKai TC adds a graceful handwritten heading, and the pair stays pleasant in modest amounts, less so over a whole page.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, its monoline curves ending well apart, under a casual handwritten LXGW WenKai TC heading. Charming in brief, but it would tire across paragraphs.
gen-gf-ma-shan-zheng-fs-bespoke-sans: Ma Shan Zheng crams its personal, pen-drawn letters tightly together, each line holding a single width from start to finish. Bespoke Sans does the sharp, refined work; the heading handles a few words.
gen-gf-ma-shan-zheng-fs-literata: Graceful and personal, Ma Shan Zheng packs its letters tight like a pen line of constant depth, above sturdy Literata. Literata carries the paragraphs; the handwriting stays in quick bursts.
gen-gf-mali-fs-neco: Casual, hand-drawn letters give Mali its inviting look up top. The strength here is Neco: a measured, authoritative serif that never pinches shut, steadying a heading best kept brief.
